title: Forward proposals pass the bounded connector comparison.
summary: Forward completes 14/14 constructed tasks and improves 16/80 retained requests; shooting completes 12/14 and improves 15/80. Both return admissible motion on the same 24 requests and cross no checkpoint. Independent replay supports only this finite criterion.
boundary: Equal caps, unequal actual work: forward uses more request transitions. Exposed requests and constructed detours share design history with the proposal family. Full masks cover 668 states. No integrated qualification, source recovery or superiority follows.
next: Qualify the forward connector inside RRT on all four original cases, with unchanged seeds, constraints and budgets. Source comparison stays closed until all four pass independent admission.
